import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { Then, When } from '@cucumber/cucumber';

When('I observe settings through the {string} actor adapter', async function (host: string) {
  const { observeInstalledReviewSettings } = await import(
    process.env.BDD_CORPUS_ACTOR_ADAPTER!
  );
  this.evidence = observeInstalledReviewSettings(
    host,
    () => process.env.BDD_CORPUS_DEFECT !== '1',
  );
  this.expectedHost = host;
});
Then('the evidence names that actor and its observed state', function () {
  assert.equal(this.evidence.host, this.expectedHost);
  assert.equal(this.evidence.reviewSettingsInstalled, true);
  assert.equal(this.evidence.observationClass, 'host-adapter');
});
